text: 为什么赚三千的女普遍不考虑赚三千的男？
en: Why do women earning three thousand generally not consider men earning three thousand?

text: 你是得有多没有常识？
en: How utterly lacking in common sense must you be?

text: 这个年龄的女性马上就要绝经了，还是更年期…
en: Women of this age are about to go through the menopause, or are already in the menopause...

text: 谁嫌弃自己生活太好了缺个祖宗吗？
en: Who complains that their life is too good and wants an extra burden to look after?

text: 中国有句老话叫：“男人四十一枝花，女人四十豆腐渣。
en: There is an old Chinese saying: “A man at forty is a flower in full bloom, a woman at forty is bean curd dregs.

text: 大多数男人四十岁的时候正值事业巅峰期，情商巅峰、智商巅峰、也有一定的存款。
en: Most men at forty are at the peak of their careers, the peak of their emotional intelligence, the peak of their intellect, and have some savings too.

text: 只要不过度喝酒熬夜，这个时期的男性尚未显老，还有一种生理特性，男人第一眼都喜欢脸蛋漂亮、身材哇塞的女人，而这个时期的女人多在24-28岁，男人向下兼容比自己小5-15岁的女人并没有什么问题。
en: So long as they do not drink excessively or stay up late, men of this age have not yet shown their age, and there is also a physiological trait: men at first sight all like women with pretty faces and stunning figures, and the women of this age group are mostly 24 to 28 years old, so it is not a problem for men to be compatible with women 5 to 15 years younger than themselves.

text: 大多数女人四十岁的时候已经明显显老，和二十多岁、三十出头的姑娘们比，明显显老，即使美图几张照片，也挡不住现实的差距；生育巅峰期已过，从35岁的高龄产妇，变成了四十岁的高危产妇，女人一旦不能生育，这个家就失去了稳定的根基和共同利益，缺少长久的利益的牵绊、互补，人与人之间的信任就会大打折扣。
en: Most women at forty have already visibly aged; compared with women in their twenties and early thirties, they have visibly aged, and even a few beautified photos cannot hide the gap in reality. Their peak childbearing years have passed; from being advanced-age mothers at thirty-five, they have become high-risk mothers at forty. Once a woman can no longer bear children, the family loses its stable foundation and common interests; lacking the long-term bonds and complementarity of interest, trust between people is greatly diminished.

text: 有些人也会举40岁明星退居二线嫁给富商的例子或40岁女星再婚的例子，这毕竟是极少数，或者高颜值女人在四十岁嫁给了她其中一个备胎。
en: Some people cite examples of forty-year-old celebrities stepping back from the spotlight to marry wealthy businessmen, or examples of forty-year-old actresses remarrying; these are, after all, a tiny minority, or cases of a good-looking woman marrying one of her backup partners at forty.

text: 男人对女人，始于颜值，陷于身材，思于性格，终于贤惠；
en: For a man towards a woman: it begins with looks, deepens with figure, ponders over character, and ends with domestic virtue;

text: 女人对男人，始于颜值，陷于财富，思于缠绵，终于生娃。
en: For a woman towards a man: it begins with looks, deepens with wealth, ponders over intimacy, and ends with having children.

text: 全球人口已超80亿，虽然是物竞天择，但是不差某性别几百万男女的基因，或者说这些人就是由于某些不足导致的一种变相的基因淘汰。
en: The global population has surpassed 8 billion. Although it is survival of the fittest, the genes of a few million men or women of a given sex are not sorely missed; or rather, these people represent a kind of disguised genetic elimination resulting from certain deficiencies.

text: 男女这点事也都是由利益决定的，事情的表象会迷惑人的心智思维，表象下面的客观规律才会给有心人明确的指引。
en: These matters between men and women are also determined by interest. The surface of things confuses people's minds and thinking; only the objective laws beneath the surface give clear guidance to those who pay attention.

text: 为什么1米6女不考虑1米6男？
en: Why do women who are 1.6 metres tall not consider men who are 1.6 metres tall?

text: 40岁的女人，现在也不考虑40岁的男人。
en: Women of forty nowadays also do not consider men of forty.

text: 我以前听婚介行业的人聊过一个很现实的现象：
en: I once heard someone in the matchmaking industry talk about a very real phenomenon:

text: 很多40多岁的未婚男人，条件并不算好，收入一般，外形一般，情绪价值也一般。
en: Many unmarried men in their forties do not have particularly good conditions: average income, average appearance, and average emotional value.

text: 但他们一开口，还是希望找三十多岁，甚至更年轻的女性。
en: But once they open their mouths, they still hope to find women in their thirties, or even younger.

text: 你问他能不能接受同龄女性，他往往很直接：
en: If you ask whether he can accept a woman of the same age, he is often very direct:

text: “不太想。
en: “Not really keen.

text: 最有意思的是，他不是一定找得到年轻女性。
en: The most interesting part is that he does not necessarily manage to find a young woman.

text: 他可能相亲很多次都失败，也可能长期单着，但依然不愿意把同龄女性纳入主要选择。
en: He may have failed at matchmaking many times, or remained single for a long time, yet still refuses to include women of his own age among his main choices.

text: 这件事如果只用“男人自信过头”来解释，有点浅。
en: If this is explained only by “men being overconfident”, it is rather superficial.

text: 它背后其实是生育、心理、社会观念、婚恋市场定价和男性自我认知共同作用的结果。
en: Behind it lies the combined effect of childbearing, psychology, social attitudes, the pricing of the marriage market, and male self-perception.

text: 第一个原因，确实是生育预期。
en: The first reason is indeed the expectation of childbearing.

text: 很多40多岁还没结婚的男人，如果此时突然想结婚，背后往往不只是想找个伴，而是想完成“结婚生子”这件事。
en: Many men in their forties who are still unmarried, if they suddenly want to marry now, often do so not merely to find a companion, but to complete the matter of “marrying and having children”.

text: 在传统婚恋逻辑里，男人会本能地把女性年龄和生育可能性绑定起来。
en: In traditional marriage logic, men instinctively link a woman's age with her likelihood of bearing children.

text: 哪怕他自己40多岁，身体状态也下降，精力也没年轻时好，经济条件也未必能支撑高质量养育，但他在择偶时仍然会倾向于认为：
en: Even though he himself is in his forties, his physical condition has declined, his energy is not what it was in his youth, and his financial situation may not support high-quality child-rearing, he still tends to believe when choosing a partner:

text: “我还可以要孩子。
en: “I can still have children.

text: “她40多岁风险就大了。
en: “Once she is in her forties, the risk is great.

text: “我要找年轻一点的更稳。
en: “I should find someone younger to be safer.

text: 这不一定公平，但确实是很多男人的底层判断。
en: This is not necessarily fair, but it is indeed the underlying judgement of many men.

text: 尤其是那些一直没结婚的男人，内心可能会有一种很强的补偿心理：
en: Especially for those men who have never married, there may be a very strong compensatory psychology within:

text: 我已经错过了很多年，现在不能再错过生育窗口。
en: I have already missed many years; I cannot miss the childbearing window again now.

text: 于是他不会把40岁女性视为“同龄伴侣”，而是直接归类为“生育风险较高”。
en: Thus he does not regard a forty-year-old woman as a “peer partner”, but directly classifies her as “higher childbearing risk”.

text: 这就是很多40女在婚恋市场里遭遇的现实困境。
en: This is the real predicament many forty-year-old women encounter in the marriage market.

text: 第二个原因，是男性对婚姻的想象，很多还停留在“我需要被照顾”。
en: The second reason is that many men's imagination of marriage still lingers at “I need to be looked after”.

text: 不少40多岁未婚男人，真正想找的不是一个势均力敌的伴侣。
en: Quite a few unmarried men in their forties do not truly want a well-matched partner.

text: 而是一个能让他重新进入家庭秩序的人。
en: but a person who can let him re-enter the family order.

text: 他想要有人做饭、有人陪伴、有人崇拜、有人提供情绪安抚，最好还能给他生孩子，帮他把“正常人生”补上。
en: He wants someone to cook, someone to keep him company, someone to admire him, someone to provide emotional comfort, and ideally someone to bear his children, helping him complete his “normal life”.

text: 年轻女性在他们想象里，代表柔软、可塑、崇拜感、家庭新鲜感。
en: In their imagination, young women represent softness, malleability, a sense of admiration, and the freshness of family life.

text: 而40岁女性在他们想象里，往往代表成熟、清醒、要求明确、不好糊弄。
en: Whereas forty-year-old women in their imagination often represent maturity, clear-headedness, clear demands, and being hard to fool.

text: 这会让一部分男人本能退缩。
en: This makes some men instinctively recoil.

text: 因为同龄女性更知道自己要什么，也更看得清男人真实条件。
en: Because women of the same age know better what they want, and see more clearly a man's true conditions.

text: 她不会轻易被几句承诺打动。
en: She will not be easily moved by a few promises.

text: 也不会因为“你是男人”就自动仰望你。
en: Nor will she automatically look up to you just because “you are a man”.

text: 她会问：
en: She will ask:

text: 你收入够不够稳定？
en: Is your income stable enough?

text: 你情绪稳不稳？
en: Are you emotionally stable?

text: 你有没有房贷债务？
en: Do you have mortgage debt?

text: 你能不能共同承担家务？
en: Can you share the housework?

text: 你父母身体怎么样？
en: How are your parents' health?

text: 你是真想结婚，还是想找人接盘生活？
en: Do you genuinely want to marry, or do you want to find someone to take over your life?

text: 这些问题太现实了。
en: These questions are too realistic.

text: 而很多40多岁条件普通的男人，恰恰不想被现实照镜子。
en: Yet many ordinary men in their forties precisely do not want to be confronted by reality as if looking in a mirror.

text: 所以他宁愿去追一个年轻女性的幻想，也不愿意面对同龄女性的清醒。
en: So he would rather chase the fantasy of a young woman than face the clear-headedness of a woman his own age.

text: 第三个原因，是传统观念给了男性一种“年龄不贬值”的错觉。
en: The third reason is that traditional ideas give men the illusion that “age does not depreciate”.

text: 很多男人从小听到的是：
en: What many men have heard since childhood is:

text: 男人四十一枝花。
en: A man at forty is a flower in bloom.

text: 男人越老越成熟。
en: The older a man, the more mature he is.

text: 男人有点经济基础就不愁找。
en: Once a man has some financial foundation, he need not worry about finding someone.

text: 男人可以找年轻的。
en: A man can find someone younger.

text: 这些话听多了，会让一部分男人产生一种错觉：
en: Hearing these words too often makes some men develop an illusion:

text: 只要我是男人，年龄就不是硬伤。
en: So long as I am a man, age is not a fatal flaw.

text: 哪怕他没有明显财富，没有成熟情绪，没有生活能力，也依然觉得自己在婚恋市场上比同龄女性更有选择权。
en: Even if he has no obvious wealth, no mature emotions, and no life skills, he still feels he has more choice in the marriage market than women of his own age.

text: 这就是社会叙事的力量。
en: This is the power of social narrative.

text: 它长期告诉女人要年轻、要保养、要抓紧结婚。
en: It has long told women to stay young, to take care of themselves, and to hurry up and marry.

text: 却很少提醒男人：
en: Yet it rarely reminds men:

text: 你也会衰老。
en: You will also grow old.

text: 你也会被筛选。
en: You will also be screened.

text: 你也需要提供价值。
en: You also need to provide value.

text: 你也不能只拿性别当筹码。
en: You cannot use gender as your only bargaining chip either.

text: 所以很多40多岁条件普通的男人，不是不知道自己条件一般，而是不愿意承认自己的婚恋价值也在下降。
en: So many ordinary men in their forties do not fail to know that their conditions are mediocre; rather, they are unwilling to admit that their marriage-market value is also declining.

text: 他宁可单着，也不愿意接受“我其实只能匹配同龄或条件相近的人”这个现实。
en: He would rather stay single than accept the reality that “I can actually only match someone my own age or of similar conditions”.

text: 因为接受这件事，对他的自尊是一种打击。
en: Because accepting this is a blow to his self-esteem.

text: 第四个原因，是他们害怕在同龄女性面前失去优势。
en: The fourth reason is that they fear losing their advantage before women of their own age.

text: 40岁女性如果还愿意结婚，多数也不是完全没要求。
en: If a forty-year-old woman is still willing to marry, most do not lack requirements entirely.

text: 她可能有工作，有见识，有生活经验，有自己的房子或存款，也经历过人情冷暖。
en: She may have a job, insight, life experience, her own home or savings, and has also experienced the warmth and coldness of human relations.

text: 她想找同龄或大几岁的男人，通常不是想扶贫，而是希望对方成熟稳重、经济更好、能照顾她。
en: She wants to find a man of her own age or a few years older; usually not to alleviate poverty, but hoping the other is mature and steady, better off financially, and able to take care of her.

text: 这其实符合传统婚恋里的“向上匹配”惯性。
en: This in fact fits the inertia of “marrying up” in traditional courtship.

text: 但问题来了。
en: But the problem arises.

text: 很多40多岁条件普通的男人，无法满足这些期待。
en: Many ordinary men in their forties cannot meet these expectations.

text: 他自己经济一般，身体精力一般，情绪价值一般，家庭负担可能还不少。
en: His own finances are mediocre, his body and energy are mediocre, his emotional value is mediocre, and his family burdens may be considerable.

text: 面对同龄女性，他没有明显优势。
en: Facing women of his own age, he has no clear advantage.

text: 甚至可能被对方一眼看穿短板。
en: He may even be seen through at a glance by the other side for his shortcomings.

text: 所以他转向年轻女性，不一定是因为年轻女性真的更适合他，而是因为他在想象里觉得自己更有优势。
en: So he turns to young women, not necessarily because young women truly suit him better, but because in his imagination he feels he has more of an advantage.

text: 他觉得自己年龄大一点，可以包装成成熟。
en: He feels that being a bit older can be packaged as maturity.

text: 收入一般，也可以说稳定。
en: Average income can also be described as stable.

text: 生活经验多一点，可以说会照顾人。
en: A bit more life experience can be said to mean being good at caring for others.

text: 可在同龄女性面前，这些包装都不值钱。
en: But before a woman of his own age, these packages are worthless.

text: 因为她也活了40年。
en: Because she too has lived forty years.

text: 她知道“成熟稳重”和“油腻逃避”的区别。
en: She knows the difference between “mature and steady” and “greasy evasion”.

text: 知道“稳定工作”和“没什么发展”的区别。
en: She knows the difference between “a stable job” and “not much prospect”.

text: 知道“想结婚”和“想找个女人补齐人生任务”的区别。
en: She knows the difference between “wanting to marry” and “wanting to find a woman to complete life's tasks”.

text: 所以男人不选同龄，有时候不是不想，而是不敢。
en: So when men do not choose someone their own age, sometimes it is not that they do not want to, but that they dare not.

text: 第五个原因，是一部分男人对女性年龄有很强的“符号化”认知。
en: The fifth reason is that some men have a strong “symbolic” perception of a woman's age.

text: 对他们来说，年轻女性不只是一个人，而是一种证明。
en: To them, a young woman is not just a person, but a kind of proof.

text: 证明自己还有吸引力。
en: Proof that they still have appeal.

text: 证明自己不算失败。
en: Proof that they are not a failure.

text: 证明自己虽然40多岁，但还能进入一段“看起来更有价值”的关系。
en: Proof that although they are in their forties, they can still enter a relationship that “looks more valuable”.

text: 这是一种很隐秘的男性自尊需求。
en: This is a very hidden need of male self-esteem.

text: 尤其是那些条件不太好的40男，越是现实里没什么优势，越可能在择偶幻想里补偿自己。
en: Especially those forty-year-old men in poor conditions: the less advantage they have in reality, the more likely they are to compensate themselves in the fantasy of choosing a partner.

text: 我钱不多，但我想找年轻的。
en: I do not have much money, but I want to find someone young.

text: 我条件一般，但我不想找同龄的。
en: My conditions are mediocre, but I do not want to find someone my own age.

text: 我找不到，也不要降低这个标准。
en: Even if I cannot find one, I will not lower this standard.

text: 表面看是挑剔，深层可能是自尊防御。
en: On the surface it looks like pickiness; deep down it may be self-esteem defence.

text: 他不是在做现实匹配，而是在捍卫一个幻想：
en: He is not making a realistic match, but defending a fantasy:

text: “我还没有老。
en: “I have not yet grown old.

text: “我还没有被市场淘汰。
en: “I have not yet been eliminated by the market.

text: “我还是可以选择年轻女性的男人。
en: “I am still a man who can choose young women.

text: 哪怕这个幻想很难落地，他也不愿意放下。
en: Even if this fantasy is hard to realise, he is unwilling to let it go.

text: 因为一旦放下，他就要承认自己也只是婚恋市场里一个普通甚至偏弱的中年男人。
en: Because once he lets it go, he must admit that he is merely an ordinary, even rather weak, middle-aged man in the marriage market.

text: 这太难受了。
en: This is too painful.

text: 第六个原因，是40岁女性在婚恋里更难被“改造”。
en: The sixth reason is that forty-year-old women are harder to “reshape” in marriage.

text: 年轻女性可能还会为了关系学习、磨合、妥协，甚至对婚姻有滤镜。
en: Young women may still study, adapt, and compromise for the sake of a relationship, and may even view marriage through rose-tinted spectacles.

text: 40岁女性通常更清楚自己的边界。
en: Forty-year-old women usually know their boundaries more clearly.

text: 她知道自己不想伺候谁。
en: She knows whom she does not want to serve.

text: 不想给谁当免费保姆。
en: She does not want to be a free nanny for anyone.

text: 不想进一段消耗型婚姻。
en: She does not want to enter a draining marriage.

text: 不想为了结婚降低底线。
en: She does not want to lower her bottom line just to get married.

text: 这本来是成熟。
en: This is maturity in itself.

text: 但在一些男人眼里，就变成“不好相处”“要求高”“不温柔”“太现实”。
en: But in the eyes of some men, it becomes “hard to get along with”, “demanding”, “not gentle”, “too realistic”.

text: 说白了，他们不是不喜欢同龄女性的年龄本身。
en: To put it bluntly, they do not dislike the age of women their own age per se.

text: 他们是不喜欢同龄女性不再轻易低头。
en: They dislike that women their own age no longer bow their heads easily.

text: 所以这个问题很现实：
en: So this issue is very real:

text: 40多岁男人为什么普遍不考虑40岁女？
en: Why do men in their forties generally not consider women of forty?

text: 因为很多男人想要的，不只是伴侣，而是年龄优势、生育想象、被照顾感、心理优越感和自尊补偿。
en: Because what many men want is not just a partner, but an age advantage, the imagination of childbearing, a sense of being cared for, a psychological sense of superiority, and compensation for self-esteem.

text: 而同龄女性恰恰很难提供这些。
en: And women of the same age precisely find it hard to provide these.

text: 她不会因为你是男人就天然崇拜你。
en: She will not naturally admire you just because you are a man.

text: 不会因为你年纪大就觉得你成熟。
en: She will not think you are mature just because you are older.

text: 不会因为你想结婚就急着配合你。
en: She will not eagerly cooperate with you just because you want to marry.

text: 不会轻易接受一个条件普通、还想占据高位的男人。
en: She will not readily accept a man of ordinary means who still wants to occupy a high position.

text: 这就形成了错位。
en: This creates a mismatch.

text: 40女多数想找同龄或大几岁、经济更好、成熟稳重、能照顾她的男人。
en: Most forty-year-old women want to find a man of their own age or a few years older, better off financially, mature and steady, who can take care of them.

text: 40男多数想找比自己年轻、压力更小、能生育、有新鲜感、最好还愿意照顾他的女人。
en: Most forty-year-old men want to find a woman younger than themselves, with less pressure, able to bear children, with a sense of freshness, and ideally willing to take care of him.

text: 双方都在向自己理想中的“更优资源”伸手。
en: Both sides reach out towards the “superior resources” of their ideals.

text: 但现实是，真正优质的资源从来有限。
en: But the reality is that truly quality resources have never been abundant.

text: 于是市场里就会剩下一批人：
en: Thus a group of people is left in the market:

text: 女方觉得同龄男不够好。
en: The woman feels the man her own age is not good enough.

text: 男方觉得同龄女不够年轻。
en: The man feels the woman his own age is not young enough.

text: 最后谁也不选谁。
en: In the end, neither chooses the other.

text: 这不是谁单方面坏。
en: This is not one side being bad unilaterally.

text: 这是婚恋市场的预期错配。
en: This is the expectation mismatch of the marriage market.

text: 当然，这不代表40岁女性就没有价值。
en: Of course, this does not mean that forty-year-old women have no value.

text: 恰恰相反，很多40岁女性更清醒、更稳定、更懂生活，也更适合做真正的伴侣。
en: On the contrary, many forty-year-old women are clearer-headed, more stable, understand life better, and are more suited to being true partners.

text: 但问题是，婚恋市场并不总按人的完整价值定价。
en: But the problem is that the marriage market does not always price people by their full value.

text: 它常常粗暴地看年龄、生育、经济、外貌、资源和性别叙事。
en: It often crudely looks at age, childbearing, finances, appearance, resources, and gender narrative.

text: 这很残酷。
en: This is cruel.

text: 也很现实。
en: And also very real.

text: 所以作为婚介工作人员，你看到的不是个例，而是婚恋市场里长期存在的一种结构性矛盾：
en: So as a matchmaking worker, what you see is not an isolated case, but a structural contradiction long present in the marriage market:

text: 女人希望男人提供更高确定性。
en: Women hope men provide greater certainty.

text: 男人希望女人提供更低年龄和更高顺从感。
en: Men hope women provide a lower age and a higher sense of submission.

text: 到了40岁以后，双方的现实条件和心理期待都更硬了，反而更难匹配。
en: After turning forty, both sides' real conditions and psychological expectations become more rigid, making a match even harder.

text: 最后我想说，40多岁男人宁可单着也不找同龄女，不一定说明他们更清醒。
en: Finally, I want to say that men in their forties would rather stay single than find a woman their own age, which does not necessarily mean they are clearer-headed.

text: 很多时候，只是他们宁愿守着幻想，也不愿面对现实匹配。
en: Much of the time, it is simply that they would rather cling to a fantasy than face a realistic match.

text: 而40岁女性如果想提高匹配率，也要非常现实地看清：
en: And if forty-year-old women want to raise their match rate, they too must see very realistically:

text: 市场不等于价值。
en: The market is not the same as value.

text: 不被某些男人选择，不代表你不值得。
en: Not being chosen by certain men does not mean you are unworthy.

text: 只是你不符合他们那套交换逻辑。
en: It only means you do not fit their set of exchange logic.

text: 真正成熟的婚恋，不是问“我还能不能找年轻的”或“他凭什么不选我”。
en: Truly mature courtship is not about asking “can I still find someone young” or “why on earth does he not choose me”.

text: 而是问：
en: but about asking:

text: 我到底能提供什么？
en: What exactly can I offer?

text: 我真正需要什么？
en: What do I truly need?

text: 我能接受什么样的人？
en: What kind of person can I accept?

text: 我不能接受什么样的婚姻？
en: What kind of marriage can I not accept?

text: 人到中年，婚恋最怕的不是单身。
en: In middle age, what one fears most in courtship is not being single.

text: 而是明明已经看过生活的真相，还被幻想拖着走。
en: but having clearly seen the truth of life, still being dragged along by fantasy.

text: 求关注、点赞。
en: Please follow and like.

text: 半醉半醒看世事，三分经历，七分思考。
en: Half drunk, half sober, watching the world; three parts experience, seven parts reflection.

text: 感谢你看到这里。
en: Thank you for reading this far.

text: 人生最大的成长，不是看透别人，而是看懂自己。
en: The greatest growth in life is not seeing through others, but understanding oneself.

text: 再会！
en: Farewell!
